//: Capability manifest for <Heading> — svelte-pure-admin. See section.map.json for the model. Heading.svelte renders a BARE <h1>..<h6> (chosen by `level`) with an optional class passthrough (`class`) and a `children` slot. Core blesses a class-less bare heading (styled by the h1..h6 type selectors), so there is no block feature — only the structural level + slot + class passthrough. `level` is a number prop (strict `===` compare in the component), so scenario values are numeric.
